senses.sense_definition: Door aanhoudend gevlei, zeuren of op slinkse wijze iets van iemand verkrijgen.

examples.text: Oplichters zijn erg creatief en zoeken steeds nieuwe manieren om mensen <w>geld</w> <w>af</w> te <w>troggelen</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: Scammers are very creative and are always looking for new ways to <w>swindle</w> people out of their money.

examples.text: Het lukte het kind om zijn grootouders wat snoep <w>af</w> te <w>troggelen</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: The child managed to <w>wheedle</w> some candy out of his grandparents.

target_lang_definitions.en: To obtain something from someone through persistent flattery, wheedling, or in a devious, cunning way.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to obtain something by persuasion or clever manipulation
to obtain something from someone through flattery or coaxing
to swindle or trick someone out of money or possessions
to gently persuade someone to give something up
